data.name: Harith
data.gender_notes: Harith is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Harith is an Arabic name that symbolizes growth, development, and prosperity. It is often associated with the Quranic concept of life and the cycle of birth and renewal. The name Harith carries the meaning “Blooming, flourishing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Harith usually hope their child will grow to embody blooming, flourishing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who brings joy and happiness, a source of light and guidance (Hadith saying: "The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) said, 'Harith is the one who brings people together and spreads love and kindness.'")
data.etymology: Harith belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blooming, flourishing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harith total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حارث
in_arabic.meaning: حارث تعني الشخص الذي يحرث الأرض أو يحصد
in_arabic.long_meaning: حارث هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يحرث الأرض أو يحصد، ويعتبر الحارث في الثقافة العربية رمزًا للعمل الجاد والزراعة. ورد اسم الحارث في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمِنَ النَّاسِ مَن يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلَى حَرْفٍ فَإِن أَصَابَتْهُ مُصِيبَةٌ تَصَدَّى لِلَّهِ وَلَين أَصبَحَ يَعُدُّ مِثْلَ حَرَّةِ الدَّنْيَا مِنَّةً'

in_urdu.name: حارث
in_urdu.meaning: حارث کا مطلب ہے زمین کا مالک یا کسان
in_urdu.long_meaning: حارث ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے زمین کا مالک یا کسان۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ محنت اور کاشتکاری کی علامت ہے۔ حارث نام کے اشخاص کو محنتی اور فلاحی کام کرنے والا سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایات میں حارث نام کا ذکر مختلف الصحابیوں اور تابعین کے سلسلے میں ملتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हारिथ
in_hindi.meaning: हारिथ का अर्थ है ज़मीन का मालिक या किसान
in_hindi.long_meaning: हारिथ एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ज़मीन का मालिक या किसान। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह मेहनत और कृषि का प्रतीक है। हरीथ नाम के व्यक्तियों को मेहनती और कल्याणकारी कार्य करने वाला माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: حارث
in_pashto.meaning: حارث د ځمکې خاوند یا بزګر معنی دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: حارث د عربي نوم دی چې د ځمکې خاوند یا بزګر معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دوديزو کې يو مهم ځای لري او د کار او کرکۍ د نښې په توګه ګڼل کیږي. د حارث نوم لرونکي کسان د سخت کارکوونکو او ټولنیزو خدمتګار په توګه پېژندل کیږي

in_english.name: Harith
in_english.long_meaning: Harith is an Arabic name meaning 'landowner' or 'farmer'. It is significant in Islamic culture as it symbolizes hard work and agriculture. The name Harith is mentioned in several Quranic verses and is associated with companions of the Prophet Muhammad. It represents diligence and community service, and individuals with this name are often seen as industrious and devoted

data.cultural_impact: The name Harith has historical and cultural influences within the Islamic community. It is believed that Harith ibn Abi Shamah was a significant member of the early Islamic community and an accomplished commander during the Islamic conquests. Harith also symbolizes the power of resilience and the ability to overcome adversity, as illustrated by the famous saying, "Harith ibn Kalada dhakkallah al-hajahan,"meaning "Harith ibn Kalada scorched the foreheads [of his enemies]."
data.spiritual_significance: In the religious context, the name Harith holds a profound spiritual meaning. The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "There is in Paradise a banquet given for Birr (good deeds) and Imaan (faith). They will be served a drink houses of Tasneem (curdled milk), Aghs'uth (honey), and Oneyb (ripe date-fruit). A man will be brought in whom they will love, and when he speaks, they will love him, and when he remains silent, they will love him, and his name will be Harith." This hadith implies that the name Harith is synonymous with righteousness, virtue, and a blissful presence in the eternal paradise.
